scope: Finite production actions consolidated from the three batch37 author registers and seven authored37boards. This is not an exhaustive atom inventory of574pages.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Distinguish pictured prohibition,warning,chemical-hazard and emergency-location classes and map each to the appropriate restricted action; text names alone do not teach recognition.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: One shared original sign-recognition set,including phone/electronics/running restrictions,fall/slip/electric and tsunami/landslide distinctions,the five named chemical hazard classes,fire/AED/evacuation locations; attach image-choice identification tasks. Clearly separate educational models from certified workplace signage.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Read actual illustrated micrometer and comparator graduations from an identified reference; the37metrology board labels parts and gives sums but does not show full readable graduation geometry.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Original micrometer main/thimble and dial/lever/bore-comparator readout panels with independently calculated tick spacing,reference/zero and at least one non-source numeric exercise for each distinct reading principle; retain instrument-specific pitch/resolution caveats.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Associate blind/through-hole details and weld leader/intermittent-segment instructions with the indicated feature; current37features board covers basic radius/diameter/thickness and four joint forms,not these remaining annotation patterns.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Extend one original feature/weld interpretation sheet with hole-depth/through examples and intermittent-weld geometry,explicit leader/reference-line convention and bounded picture-based checks. Do not create operating instructions.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Locate sampled positions and distinguish average thickness from local minimum/maximum,without treating a mean as acceptance at every position.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: One independently dimensioned sample-position sketch with original measurements and a mean-versus-extreme check tied to those positions.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Distinguish characteristic-X-ray and eddy-current thickness-measurement concepts/instrument roles from hardness and substrate effects; prose names do not establish the recorded visual distinction.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Two conceptual measurement panels labeling excitation/detection versus probe/substrate relationship and one method-selection check. No reproduced device photo,accuracy guarantee or universal calibration recipe.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Identify wetting/non-wetting observations on the assessed specimen; material examples alone do not demonstrate recognition.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Original contrasting specimen-observation images with an observation-only classification task and separation of appearance from process authorization.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Locate holding points,required electrical contacts and protected/coated areas; new material-family prose and film cross-section do not show a jig/contact layout.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: One original rack/jig contact diagram showing mechanical holding,required conductive contact and unwanted deposition area; task to identify which contact must remain conductive,with material/bath compatibility caveats.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Associate indicator identity and transition colors; the new instruments sheet teaches menisci and scales but contains no indicator-color comparison.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Original phenolphthalein,methyl-orange,BTB color-reference comparison plus identity-first color interpretation checks; product-specific pH strips remain outside this educational chart.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Use the source-listed relative metal/hydrogen ordering for a bounded comparison while recognizing passivation/environment caveats; current prose does not supply the recorded full16entry recognition aid.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: An independently laid out16entry order/reference card with hydrogen position and an original comparison exercise; explicitly prohibit inferring universal acid dissolution or corrosion rate.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Recognize the five named circuit symbols and relate current/field/force directions; source ledger records no complete original symbol set or controlled hand-direction diagram.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: One original electrical concept pack:five symbol cards with polarity conventions,field/current directional visualization and distinct Fleming-direction task; preserve each rule’s applicability and do not turn it into wiring permission.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Map treatment classes to substrate/film purpose in a visible classification rather than identify processes only by a name list.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Original classification tree plus representative substrate/film-category matching task. Keep table thickness ranges as source examples rather than process settings; no need to copy each numerical cell.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Recognize treatment/rinse/dry sequence and distinguish electroplating from hot-dip flow without inferring one universal pretreatment recipe.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Original process cards with interstage rinsing and optional/approved branches explicitly marked; one sequence-discrimination exercise comparing electroplating and hot dip.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Calculate a chosen plated area including/excluding specified edges,and distinguish rack/barrel/continuous-strip arrangements; recorded enlarged diagram arithmetic remains open.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Original labeled workpiece with new dimensions,explicit face/edge inclusion and independently checked area totals; adjacent rack/barrel/strip sketches with a recognition task. No current-density setting recipe.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Recognize unplated areas,discoloration,low gloss,scratches and localized buff dwell observations; prior cross-section already distinguishes blister/pinhole/pit but is not complete appearance recognition.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: An original controlled defect-image set for the remaining visible categories with observation-versus-possible-cause questions; preserve existing cross-section teaching rather than redraw it as proof of real-photo certification.

requiredOpenItems.missingRecognitionOrKnowledgeGoal: Recognize tool contact/rotation context and coarse-scratch-to-finish progression without treating grit as a fixed Ra conversion.
requiredOpenItems.concreteArtifactNeeded: Original stopped-tool conceptual diagram and before/after surface profiles across independently authored stages; ask whether prior scratches remain. Keep abrasive composition verification and no guaranteed grit/Ra mapping.
